hook: Iron Gate: US targets Iran's land routes
reel_hook: Iran's land routes are now a target.

slides.title: US targets Iran's land routes
slides.image_prompt: A heavy iron gate closing across a dusty desert road at dusk, a lone cargo truck stopped before it, an oil tanker on the distant sea
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
CENTCOM launched Iron Gate to disrupt Iran's land routes.
WHY IT MATTERS
It widens a sea blockade CENTCOM says stopped ~$25bn of oil.
FOR YOU
Iran also lifted its 2,000 km missile limit as peace talks continue.
slides.body: CENTCOM launched Iron Gate to disrupt Iran's land routes. It widens a sea blockade CENTCOM says stopped ~$25bn of oil. Iran also lifted its 2,000 km missile limit as peace talks continue.

slides.title: Six killed in Kraków square
slides.image_prompt: Rows of lit memorial candles on old cobblestones at dusk, the arcades of a historic European square softly blurred in the background
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
A gunman killed six in Kraków's Main Market Square.
WHY IT MATTERS
Poland's PM called it terrorism; an investigation is open.
FOR YOU
About 15 were injured and one victim was British. Poland is in mourning.
slides.body: A gunman killed six in Kraków's Main Market Square. Poland's PM called it terrorism; an investigation is open. About 15 were injured and one victim was British. Poland is in mourning.

slides.title: Eisenkot tapped over Netanyahu
slides.image_prompt: An empty leather chair at the head of a long wooden table in a stately hall, morning light, a single folded document waiting on it
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Herzog chose Gadi Eisenkot to try to form Israel's government.
WHY IT MATTERS
Parties with 67 of 120 Knesset seats recommended him.
FOR YOU
He has 28 days, which can be extended, to build a 61-seat majority.
slides.body: Herzog chose Gadi Eisenkot to try to form Israel's government. Parties with 67 of 120 Knesset seats recommended him. He has 28 days, which can be extended, to build a 61-seat majority.

slides.title: New Zealand vote: too close
slides.image_prompt: A ballot box on a wooden table beside a perfectly balanced brass scale, green fern leaves in soft morning light
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
New Zealand's election has no clear winner yet.
WHY IT MATTERS
Labour narrowly leads the vote; the ruling bloc has a one-seat majority.
FOR YOU
Special votes still need counting, which could take up to about three weeks.
slides.body: New Zealand's election has no clear winner yet. Labour narrowly leads the vote; the ruling bloc has a one-seat majority. Special votes still need counting, which could take up to about three weeks.

slides.title: NZ parliament grows to 131
slides.image_prompt: A semicircle of green parliament benches with eleven extra chairs squeezed in at the edges, warm light, empty chamber
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
New Zealand's parliament is set for a record 131 seats.
WHY IT MATTERS
A party won more local seats than its vote share earned.
FOR YOU
Normally 120 seats; now 66 are needed for a majority, not 61.
slides.body: New Zealand's parliament is set for a record 131 seats. A party won more local seats than its vote share earned. Normally 120 seats; now 66 are needed for a majority, not 61.

caption:
🚧 The US launched 'Iron Gate' to target Iran's land routes, and Iran dropped its 2,000 km missile limit.
🕯️ Six killed in a shooting in Kraków's Main Market Square. Poland is in mourning.
🏛️ Herzog picked Gadi Eisenkot, not Netanyahu, to form a government: 28 days, which can be extended.
🗳️ New Zealand's election is too close to call. Special votes could take about three weeks.
🪑 Curious: NZ's parliament is set for a record 131 seats, so 66 now make a majority.
